title: Meet Your Neighbor
summary: You arrive at Linden House with two suitcases. Your neighbour Alex is carrying boxes up the stairs. Introduce yourself and tell Alex a little about your life.
npc_opening: Oh, hi! You must be the new neighbour. I'm Alex, I live in 3B. Welcome to Linden House! Where are you from?

objectives.description: Say your name and where you are from.
Tell Alex something you usually do every day or every week.

decision_points.prompt: Alex is struggling with a heavy box of plant pots. Do you offer to help?

options.label: Help Alex carry the boxes upstairs.
Say you are too tired after the journey.
